title: Optional-output decoding
statement: For every optional bit $b$ and every bit string $x$, reading the two-bit code for $b$—$00$ for no output, $10$ for output $0$, and $11$ for output $1$—followed by $x$ succeeds and returns $(b,x)$.
replaced:
For every optional output bit $b$ (no output, output $0$, or output $1$) and
every bit string $x$, the optional-output reader applied to the two-bit
dictionary code of $b$ ($00$, $10$, or $11$ respectively) followed by $x$
succeeds and returns $(b, x)$.
